label: v239
changes: The welcome and sign-off screens of the app tour now get the same bold black card as the guided setup, so the two introductions finally look like they came from the same app.
The middle of the tour is untouched on purpose — those steps point at a real button on your screen, and a heavy card next to the highlight pulls your eye away from the very thing it's pointing at.
Both of those screens can now scroll if your phone is small enough that the text runs past the bottom, so the Next button is always reachable.
